content.text: Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/confirmation-visible/lru/solution.py`. It tracks hits/misses with an LRU list, moves hits to most-recently-used, evicts the least-recently-used on overflow, records evictions in order, and handles non-positive capacity by treating every access as a miss with empty cache/evictions.
